title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bundt Cake
description: A moist, perfectly sweet, lemony homemade bundt cake topped with lemon glaze.
equipment: stand mixer with paddle, or hand mixer

items.note: or as needed to thin the glaze

step_groups.name: Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and poppy seeds together. Set aside.
In a stand mixer with the paddle, or a large bowl with a hand mixer, beat the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla. Slowly mix in the lemon juice, lemon zest and oil.
Add the flour mixture and the sour cream alternately, starting and ending with the flour. Mix until just combined.
Spray a 10-inch (25 cm) bundt pan well with nonstick spray. Pour in the batter and spread it evenly.
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. If it's browning too much, cover it loosely with foil for the last 5 to 10 minutes.
Cool in the pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes, then turn the cake out onto the rack to finish cooling.

step_groups.name: Glaze
steps: In a small bowl, mix the confectioners' sugar and lemon juice until fully combined.
Once the cake is cool, set a piece of foil under the rack to catch drips. Pour the glaze evenly over the cake and let it set for about 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.

notes: No bundt pan? Bake it in two 8x8-inch (20 x 20 cm) cake pans instead.
storage: Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days. The unglazed cake can be frozen for up to 3 months; thaw to room temperature before serving.
